summary: Remove condition rows from a material rate table (Project)
description: Removes one or more condition rows from a project-level material rate table by expiring all associated rate values on the project row and cascading the removal UP to the 1:1 company parent. Material-only (non-material rate tables return 403). Returns 207 with one result per condition; per-condition failures are isolated (one bad condition does not affect the others).

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the company

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the project

parameters.name: rate_table_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the project-level material rate table

207.description: Multi-Status: one result per condition (200 = removed or no-op, 422 = validation error). Successful entries report the count of expired rate values (project row + company parent).

401.description: Although the HTTP standard specifies "unauthorized", semantically this response means "unauthenticated". That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.

403.description: The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is authenticated, but the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401, the client's identity is known to the server.

404.description: The server can not find the requested resource. This can mean either the URL is not recognized, or the resource itself does not exist. Servers may also send this response instead of 403 to hide the existence of a resource from an unauthorized client.

422.description: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

500.description: Fail-closed data-integrity error: the project material rate table is missing or has an out-of-scope company parent (`copied_from`). The whole request is aborted before any rate value is expired.

conditions.description: Array of condition expressions to remove (1-100 items). All entries must match the rate table resource category: { work_classification_id } for LABOR or { equipment_type_id } for EQUIPMENT.
